# check reports a pending journal without changing it.
exec tuck$exe init
mkdir tasks/.tuck/txn
cp unfinished.txt tasks/.tuck/txn/unfinished

exitcode 1 check --json
json
stdout '"ok": false'
stdout '"path": "tasks/.tuck/txn"'
stdout 'interrupted operation needs recovery'
stderr 'found 1 board issue'
exists tasks/.tuck/txn/unfinished
cmp tasks/.tuck/txn/unfinished unfinished.txt

-- unfinished.txt --
unfinished journal marker
